column1: # Technical terms as they are spoken: exact written form (case matters)<TAB>the words to say.
# Applied before the text rules (dizione) and the word list, as a lookup, never a guess: add a term
# after hearing it come out wrong. A run of capitals is spelled (AWS); keep it joined, since a lone A or I reads as a word.
# Acronyms said letter by letter (Tim, 16 Nov: "VLLM, like each letter spoken"). A plural spells its
# letters apart, since a joined run with an s reads as a word ("LLMs" came out "lelms").
